steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8098/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as given). Then go to the Assets list and find every asset whose name starts with 'Seed:'. Report each one's name and its asset tag exactly as displayed on the page.

02-create: In Snipe-IT, create a new Asset (hardware) with the name exactly '{{runid}} Bench Asset'. Set its model to 'Bench Laptop Model' (choose the option from the searchable dropdown, do not create a new model), status to 'Ready to Deploy' (choose from the status dropdown), default location to 'Bench Office' (choose from the location dropdown), and purchase date to 2026-03-15. Fill any other required fields sensibly but do not create new models, locations, or users. Save the asset, then report the asset tag Snipe-IT assigned to it and confirm the model, status, location and purchase date shown on the asset's page.

03-create: On the Snipe-IT asset page for the asset named '{{runid}} Bench Asset' (asset tag {{02-create.asset_tag}}, at /hardware/{{02-create.url.p1}}), perform a Check Out action: check the asset out to the user 'Bench Assignee' (choose the user from the searchable dropdown, do not create a new user), and include a note whose text contains '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Checked out for {{runid}} bench testing'). Complete the checkout. Then report: the purchase date shown on the asset's detail page, the status shown, the location shown, and the checked-out-to user shown on the asset page.

04-open: Open the Snipe-IT asset page for the asset with tag {{02-create.asset_tag}} (at /hardware/{{02-create.url.p1}}) and read back from the page: (1) the asset's name, (2) the Model shown, (3) the Status shown, (4) the {{02-create.default_location_label}} shown, (5) the Purchase date shown, (6) the user it is currently checked out to, and (7) open the {{03-create.history_heading}}/checkout entries and report the note text attached to the checkout. Report each value exactly as displayed. Do not change anything.
